full_page.content:
c. 1957, March
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O. F.M. Cap. (added by hand to a letter written by niece, Clemence Carbis)
Feast of St. Joseph.
God bless you Dear Fr. Ed'wd.
It is nearly time for office - Matins - Lauds -
I want to answer the above Tonight if I can
I perhaps should have told the secret before - of having prayers heard in "hopeless cases." Any how I think a few little notes near by will be interestingly Encouring - over.
I had to cross proposed P.S. off.
- can only hope to do something
better than just a P.S.
Another letter from same
niece Clement informs of
the operation . -
Let us continue praying
and trusting and thanking -
God first of course and then all else ...
Since the novices are gone
I've been having - so far - the
privilege of serving Fr. Rudolph's Mass
every morning. I really enjoy it but - but -
One hardly knows how to get around.
Fr. Solanus ofm cap.
Blessed be God!
